name: Spam Catcher » Forged YouTube sender >> Deleted Messages
comments: Spam forging a youtube.com From (e.g. "Man Problems=kcbsv", "SexSecrets=kxcfi", "MaleElongator hjugf" <no-reply@youtube.com>) fails DKIM and bounces via @youtube.com or @ofsys.com.
Genuine YouTube / YouTube Music mail always has a Return-Path at *.bounces.google.com (scoutcamp, youtube-subscriptions) and passes DKIM/DMARC.
Checked 2026-10-03 against 1,631 youtube.com messages in Deleted Messages: 1,065 forged, 566 genuine, no overlap.
Priority 90, not the usual spam 200, so it runs before Notifications » Entertainment » YouTube (priority 100), which would otherwise claim this mail first.
